gaps.title: Statutory reporting
gaps.why: The Feb 28 (paper) / Mar 31 (electronic) dates come from DOR Directive 07-2 (2007, US-MAB5-302), which the Aug 2026 Withholding Tax Guide still echoes. The newer DOR W-2 page (updated 2026-01-30, US-MAS5-015) says January 31, and 830 CMR 62B.2.1(d) fixes January 31 for the employee statement (US-MAB5-301). No TIR or Directive formally replacing 07-2 was found. Filing by January 31 meets every candidate deadline, so the build can configure January 31 without risk.

gaps.what_would_close_it: A DOR TIR/Directive superseding Directive 07-2, or a DOR confirmation that January 31 applies to W-2 filing with DOR.
